{{Quote|&hellip;You can see the Vankaysar Bridge burning from here. No one's saying what happened, but I haven't seen anything like it.|A Zakuulan|<ref name="KotFE 10">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=10}}</ref>}}
The '''Vankaysar Bridge''' was a bridge located in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] and its [[Eternal Empire]]. At one point, the bridge was the subject of an attack by the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Kaliyo Djannis|Firebrand]].<ref name="KotFE 10" />
